race.comment: LULU DARLING (5) obviously didn't have things go to plan at Bendigo. However they have switched up some gear this time to help make her settle. Some other recent form lines were certainly up to this type of event. That said, ALPINOVA (9) is racing very consistently. She came from last her last two and only had one finish in front of her. If she can run the trip she will be hard to hold out. Is backing up smartly. OCEAN'S JEN (4) had a lot of ground to make up at Moe and from this barrier, probably won't need to do that here. Can find her WA form. KADDARI (1) will be getting a sweet run all the way. It seems a nice distance to kick off at.
